messages:
Maria (Design): Pushed a small prototype to staging for the trace viewer UX we've been iterating on. Would love quick eyes on callstack folding and the correlation ID affordance.

Devon (Eng): Nice, I can pull it down. Where did you put the 'copy correlation id' control?

Maria (Design): It's on the top-right of the request drilldown header next to the timestamp — a little clipboard icon. Thinking 'Copy correlation ID' tooltip.

Ash (Product): Prefer text = 'Copy correlation ID' (ID uppercase). Also can we show a toast with a link "Open in logs" after copy? Common flow.

Irene (Accessibility): A couple of quick a11y nits: the clipboard icon currently has no aria-label; screen readers see just "button". Need aria-label="Copy correlation ID" and focus visible outline. Also keyboard nav: icon should be reachable via Tab before the related export button.

Devon (Eng): Good catch. The icon was implemented as a span with onclick for the prototype. I'll switch to a real button with aria-label and tabindex.

Sam (SRE): One more: when traces are >200 spans the callstack panel chokes. Can we lazy-load nested frames and collapse repeated frames by default? Folding would hide repeated runtime frames, with a small chevron to expand.

Maria (Design): Proposal: collapse sequences of identical frames into a single row like "... 12 repeated frames (show)". That keeps the visual rhythm and reduces noise. Is that feasible?

Devon (Eng): Feasible. We'll need server-side aggregation for long traces or client-side dedupe when the trace payload arrives. Prefer client-side for speed, but will benchmark.

Irene (Accessibility): If you collapse, ensure expanded content is reachable by screen reader and that the "show" control is a descriptive button. Avoid ambiguous "+" icons.

Ash (Product): Another UX point: export actions. Right now we have both an inline "Export" CTA and a kebab menu with "Export JSON/CSV". Would rather centralize — either a primary export button or move to kebab. Thoughts?

Maria (Design): My leaning is kebab menu for secondary exports and a single primary "Download trace" action when the drilldown is open. Keeps toolbar clean.

Devon (Eng): Agree kebab for CSV and JSON variants; primary action should be "Download trace (full)". Implementation note: large JSON can be 10s of MB — stream it rather than building in-memory.

Sam (SRE): Streamed endpoint + signing required for private deployments. Also add a warning for "Export may contain sensitive fields" and a checkbox in enterprise/private to scrub headers by default.

Maria (Design): Copy tweak: change "Open raw span" to "View raw span details" — clearer. Also color contrast on error badges: the current red fails AA at 12px. We should bump contrast or bold text.

Irene (Accessibility): Confirmed — current #d9534f on white fails. Use #c21807 or add a 700-weight to meet 4.5:1 at 12px. Also ensure tooltips are keyboard accessible and have role="tooltip" attached to the trigger.

Devon (Eng): I'll update styles. For timeline scrubber: can we show hover time and span count at the pointer? Designers want microfeedback.

Maria (Design): Yes — small floating card on hover with "t=1.2s · 24 spans". Keep it subtle. If the scrubber is keyboard-focused, show the same card anchored to the scrubber handle.

Ash (Product): Quick question re correlation IDs: Should we allow clicking the correlation ID to start a global search across the traces dashboard? That'd be a big usability win.

Maria (Design): Yes, clicking the ID should open search with the ID prefilled. For privacy, add a confirmation if the project has cross-tenant access.

Devon (Eng): We'll wire click -> /traces?q=correlation_id:xxxx. For large orgs, we can add a scoped toggle.

Sam (SRE): Performance note: index correlation IDs in our trace store to make that query fast. Otherwise searches time out.

Maria (Design): Final items for this round: (1) aria-labels for all icon buttons, (2) collapsed repeated frames display pattern, (3) primary download + kebab variants, (4) contrast bump on error badges, (5) hover scrubber card, (6) copy toast with "Open in logs" link.

Devon (Eng): I'll make a PR with the button/aria changes and callstack folding prototype.

Irene (Accessibility): Happy to review the PR for a11y specifics.

Ash (Product): I'll draft the product note for enterprise about export sensitive-data defaults.

deploy-bot: Deployed "trace-viewer/prototype-2026-03" to staging (stg).

Maria (Design): Thanks all — tagging @devon and @irene. Please leave any follow-ups here, otherwise I'll iterate on the prototype and update mockups. :sparkles:

Devon (Eng): Taking action items. Will post benchmarks for callstack folding and large trace streaming by EOD tomorrow.

Irene (Accessibility): Will do a quick screen-reader walkthrough once the PR is up.

Ash (Product): LGTM :+1:
